InventoryEntry.description: An entry of the content model.

declaration.description:
Where `ascribe.toml` declares it; `null` for a built-in note type,
and for an entry that can't be found there.

key.description: Its key, id, or name, as pages write it.

kind.description: What kind of entry it is.

label.description: Its label, name, or term, where it has one besides its key.

uses.description:
How many places use it; `null` for a build, which pages don't name,
and for a glossary term with `match = "marked"`, whose uses are links
to its page.

includedBy.description: The content paths of the files that include it, in order.

InventoryNavPage.description: A page in a section of the navigation.

path.description: Its content path, as `pages` has it.

placed.description:
Whether it has its place: its section lists no pages, or lists it.
One that isn't comes after those that are, and `nav-page-unplaced`
reports it.

builds.description:
The builds that publish it, in declaration order: the ones This
page's Builds row says publish it.

incoming.description: How many links from other files, and includes, name it.

type.description: Its content type; `null` when no one type applies.

InventorySection.description: A section of the navigation: a folder and its pages, in order.

folder.description: Its folder, from the content root, ending in `/`; `""` for the root.

label.description:
Its label: `label` from `ascribe.nav`, else its own page's title,
else its folder's name, and "Start" for the root.

labelSet.description: The `label` `ascribe.nav` gives it, when it gives one.

listsPages.description:
Whether `ascribe.nav` lists its pages, so a page it leaves out isn't
placed.

page.description:
The content path of its own page: its `index.md`, or the page beside
the folder with its name, which is then one of its parent's `pages`
too, and the section sits where it does.

pages.description: Its pages in order, its own page not among them.

sections.description:
Its nested sections: each whose own page is among `pages` sits
there; the rest come after the pages, in this order.

LspPosition.description:
A position in a document: a zero-based line, and a zero-based column in
the position encoding the client and server agreed on.

character.description: The column, from 0, in the negotiated position encoding.

LspRange.description: A range in a document, from `start` up to (not including) `end`.

ModelKind.description: A kind of content model entry.

description:
The answer to `ascribe/inventory`. A document that isn't one of the
project's files gets empty lists.

contentUri.description:
The `file:` URI of the content root, which content paths are
relative to.

model.description:
The content model's entries: phrases, features, glossary terms,
dimensions, note types, widgets, then builds, each kind in
declaration order.

modelUri.description:
The `file:` URI of the project's `ascribe.toml`, which the ranges of
declarations are in.

navigation.description:
The project's navigation (SPEC §7.8), `ascribe.nav`'s order over the
default: its root section. `null` for a document that isn't one of
the project's files.

orphans.description:
The content paths of the pages no other file links to or includes,
other than index pages (`index.md`, in any folder). Without a
navigation file a reader may still reach them, so this is a hint.

title: InventoryResult
